dataset_info.title: Suzumiya Haruhi no Tsuisou (PSP) - Yuki Nagato Portraits Modular Sprite Dataset
dataset_info.game: Suzumiya Haruhi no Tsuisou (The Reminiscence of Haruhi Suzumiya)
dataset_info.assembly_instructions: To assemble any pose with any of its 12 expressions and 3x3 blink/talk states: 1) Load the pose's base_body.png; 2) Alpha-composite the chosen eye frame (eye_01_open, eye_02_half_blink, or eye_03_closed) at (eye_local_offset_x, eye_local_offset_y); 3) Alpha-composite the chosen mouth frame (mouth_01_closed, mouth_02_half_open, or mouth_03_open) at (mouth_local_offset_x, mouth_local_offset_y).

expression_grid_catalog.description_en: Relaxed level eyebrows, calm forward gaze behind round glasses, neutral mouth
Relaxed eyebrows, warm forward gaze behind round glasses, gentle smiling mouth
Eyes closed in cheerful upward arcs behind round glasses across all blink frames, warm smile
Slightly lowered inner eyebrows, focused forward gaze behind round glasses, serious mouth
Upturned worried inner eyebrows, concerned forward gaze behind round glasses, small downturned mouth
Deeply upturned sad eyebrows, slightly lowered upper eyelids behind round glasses, dejected mouth
Sharply furrowed inner eyebrows, firm direct glare behind round glasses, tense mouth
Raised high eyebrows, widened surprised eyes behind round glasses, small parted mouth
Glistening tears pooling at lower eyelids behind round glasses, sad upturned eyebrows, trembling mouth
Eyes shifted to her left (viewer's right) behind round glasses, pensive eyebrows, quiet mouth
Upturned sympathetic eyebrows, soft forward gaze behind round glasses, gentle reassuring smile
Closed eyelids with subtle tear droplets at outer corners behind round glasses, sad upturned eyebrows
